about.title: About TopDog Labs
about.subtitle: A one-person iOS studio crafting focused, intentional apps.
about.summaryBody: We build iOS apps that feel calm, reliable, and delightful to use. Every project prioritizes clean SwiftUI interfaces, privacy-first decisions, offline-first design, and thoughtful onboarding — so users can jump in and feel at home immediately.

sections.title: What we build
sections.body: Focused mobile experiences: quick-play games, productivity tools, creative utilities, and anything that benefits from native iOS polish. No clutter, no ads, no unnecessary permissions.

sections.title: How we work
sections.body: Small scope, high attention to detail. We ship fast, listen to real users, and iterate steadily. Every release includes accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type), iCloud sync where it makes sense, and strict attention to modern Swift concurrency and performance.

sections.title: Tech we love
sections.body: SwiftUI for declarative, beautiful UIs • Swift 6 with strict concurrency • CloudKit for seamless iCloud sync • SwiftData for local persistence • RevenueCat for clean premium unlocks • MijickCamera & AVFoundation for advanced capture • Bedrock for consistent design tokens and components • Full accessibility & Dynamic Type support from day one.

sections.title: Guiding principles
sections.body: Privacy by default — no tracking, no analytics, minimal data collection. Offline-first whenever possible. Thoughtful first-time experiences (welcome sheets, spotlight tours). Haptics, animations, and sound used intentionally to make interactions feel premium.

about.closing: TopDog Labs is a solo effort by Matt Bruce in Frisco, Texas. We’re here to ship apps that respect your time and attention.

sections.title: Where can I get support?
sections.body: Email info@topdoglabs.com and include the app name, device, and iOS version.

sections.title: How do I report a bug?
sections.body: Send steps to reproduce and screenshots if possible. We review all reports.

sections.title: Do you offer refunds?
